name: How can I prevent future kitchen drywall damage?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future kitchen drywall damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing future kitchen drywall damage involves proactive measures. Regularly check for plumbing leaks under sinks, behind appliances, and around windows. Address any water issues promptly. Install exhaust fans to reduce humidity and condensation. Use splash guards where appropriate. Consider moisture-resistant drywall for renovations. Be mindful when moving appliances or objects to avoid impacts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent damage by checking for leaks, controlling humidity with exhaust fans, using splash guards, and being careful with impacts.
